provenance: Approval transcript supplied directly in the coordinator's delegation; historical messages were not retrieved.
finalFocusedReview: Reported complete by the coordinator in the supplied proposal; this record is not a new independent review.
activationAmendment: The coordinator explicitly confirmed that the supplied approval covers only the minimal activation revision, refreshed pins and affected nonlive checks.

scope.preflight: same-process no-turn preflight within each session budget; any failed check blocks the packet without retry or fallback
scope.localFortCredential: temporary enrollment; expiry no later than ten minutes from first start, including gap; exact cleanup after completion or failure
scope.manualOperator: owner operates the pinned Mac app while coordinator verifies results

disclosedStartupAuthority: Codex starts with the Mac user's access before configuration checks finish and may access existing provider storage or initialize configured integrations during startup.
remainingReadinessGate: Wait for the coordinator to relay that the owner is at the Mac ready to operate the app before runtime startup, enrollment or either timer.
excluded: new sign-in, credential copying or API-key fallback
extra starts, messages, retries or relaxed preflight
OS settings changes, deployment or permanent services
provider cleanup or broader hosting approval
